snippet.title: Nocternum | Official Indie Game Trailer
snippet.description:
In an apocalyptic world overrun by demons, play as a young hero summoned by a mysterious ritual in a desperate attempt to restore balance. Battle terrifying creatures that lurk in the dark with the help of your canine companion. Build a home base in hell for some new and unusual friends you meet along the way. Grow your resistance, and take the fight to those who let the world fall to corruption.

Wishlist Nocternum on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4012520/Nocternum

http://nocternum.com
